voltage_scope: Before routed PCB/source/Ground drop and dynamic excursions.
assumptions: Independent 0.1% initial resistor tolerance and 25ppm/C TCR for each divider resistor.
Both resistor temperatures and converter junction remain within -40..125C.
TPS61033 is forced into PWM; PFM voltage uplift is not allowed.
Reference and leakage bounds are the manufacturer's stated electrical-characteristic limits.
TPD13S523 maximum 205mV drop at55mA is used; maximum voltage assumes zero drop.
No claimed bound on converter ripple, startup overshoot, load transient, PCB inductance or input-rail impedance.
limitations: This calculation does not establish a complete HDMI power compliance guarantee.
The old5mV PCB/Ground allocation is withdrawn; actual routed source-path sensitivity is in joint-routing-proposal/routed-ir-sensitivity.json, with Ground and transients still unqualified.
Determine dynamic allowances only after qualifying actual routed source/Ground drop and then validate the4.8..5.3V output window.
Effective output capacitance must be qualified after DC bias, tolerance, temperature and ageing.
